status: complete; selected formats frozen before full Detection and Text
user_revision: User requested High-only format search and target concurrency 48. Full benchmark still requires Low and High.
selection_rule: Choose highest High mAP@50 among valid format implementations; report mAP@50:95 and failure rates. Near-ties require uncertainty analysis before claiming superiority. Same selected format is used for full Low and High; Low optimality is not established by this search.
failures: Retain all failures and token charges; API errors, empty and truncated outputs count as empty detections in search scoring. Do not cherry-pick retries based on mAP.
preprocessing: Existing OpenRouter JPEG upload and EXIF transpose. Uploaded dimensions explicitly equal original dimensions when encoder does not resize.

source_evidence.minimax: Model card, chat template, image processor and API guide/index inspected. No explicit bounding-box output convention found in these sources. This is not proof no guidance exists anywhere.
source_evidence.nemotron: Exact post-trained BF16 model card, official super35 guide, evaluation, SFT and paper summaries inspected. Grounding training is mentioned, but no required box output convention identified.
source_evidence.kimi: Official Chinese K3.1 quickstart retrieved after English endpoint returned 403. Related K3 model card retained as family context, not exact-model evidence.
